name: ref-consistency-check-failed
displayName: REF consistency check FAILED on a workstation
description: A REF consistency scan reported a FAIL (REF event 3002). The alert lists the failed checks per computer; the full results are in the REF event log and C:\ProgramData\REF\Reports\consistency-latest.json. Standing requirement 8 Oct 2026; NIST 3.3.4, 3.14.6.

criteria.query:
Event
| where EventLog == 'REF' and Source == 'REF-Consistency' and EventID == 3002
| extend Check = trim(' ', extract('CHECK=([^|]+)', 1, RenderedDescription)), Detail = extract('DETAIL=(.*)$', 1, RenderedDescription)
| summarize Failures = count(), Checks = make_set(Check, 25), Example = take_any(Detail), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
